Title: Nitin's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Nitin - 36 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Neeta - 61 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Pallavi - 35 years, friend
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Nitin stands by the road. Neeta stands near him.]

Nitin: "Let's do something fun today."

[Nitin withdraws cash from the ATM.]

Neeta (surprised): "Nitin, listen!"

[Nitin counts the notes and puts them in his wallet.]

Nitin: "What a day to remember!"
